sources.price_per_share: TWSE closing price on 2026-09-14 (manual fallback input; the automatic valuation uses the latest official close)
sources.shares_issued_thousands: FY2025 financial statements, issued and paid-in shares (MOPS)
sources.cash_flow: Manual cash-flow figures, used only when the automatic valuation is unavailable: 2023-2024 are hand estimates, 2025 is the full-year MOPS annual report.
sources.beta: 5-year monthly beta vs TWSE, market consensus (manual fallback input)
sources.equity_risk_premium: Damodaran country equity risk premium, Taiwan: https://pages.stern.nyu.edu/adamodar/New_Home_Page/datafile/ctryprem.html
sources.terminal_growth_ceiling: Taiwan long-run nominal GDP growth projection (~3.5%, DGBAS / IMF WEO)
